row-level-security: Enabling and forcing RLS changes only metadata on the new empty population tables created in the same migration, under 1s lock_timeout and 30s statement_timeout.
create-policy: The owner and public-law reader policies are catalog-only metadata on the new empty population tables created in the same migration, under 1s lock_timeout and 30s statement_timeout.
create-trigger: The statement-level projection triggers on case_law_decisions and the new projection table register catalog entries without scanning rows; SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE is held only for the statement, under 1s lock_timeout and 30s statement_timeout.
unresolved-execute: Both EXECUTE statements run inside function bodies at call time, not during the migration: one inserts aggregated deltas into the population queue and the other projects one bounded seed batch. Neither issues DDL or takes a relation lock beyond row writes.
